t: The Brackenheath iSpot Deco is a mains-powered LED up and down wall light designed for decorative and security illumination. Ideal for electricians installing exterior lighting on domestic and commercial properties, this IP65 rated fixture features a durable black polycarbonate body and lens, housing a 6.5W integrated LED that delivers 750lm of cool white light. A built-in PIR and photocell sensor offers 180° detection up to 10m, providing adjustable dusk-to-dawn operation. The unit offers 4-in-1 control and can control up to 8 fittings, (max. 150W LED load) when linked in series.
b: Series Linking Capability Controls 8 Light Fittings
